head: feature/task/T-056
title: F-FND-008 Pipeline Foundation (T-008): W3C correlation IDs + Problem+JSON closed code list + CORS allow-list + auth rate limiting + TA-10.2 telemetry set
body:
## Summary

Closes milestone **T-008 / F-FND-008** — the API pipeline foundation: W3C `traceparent` parsing with an 8-hex correlationId on every request (TA-10.1), Problem+JSON from a closed TA-4.1.3 code list (TA-4.1.3), CORS allow-list from config (TA-4.1.6), auth rate limiting at the API layer — 5/min per IP (TA-9.5, `AspNetCoreRateLimit` frozen 5.0.0 with an ADR row in Open-Decisions-and-Constants.md) — and the TA-10.2 closed telemetry event/metric set plus `WaTelemetryReporter` on the existing Serilog pipeline (no new packages). T-009's first real endpoint inherits all four guarantees without re-deciding any of them.

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-056-1 every request carries a correlation ID | W3CTraceParserTests — 24 cases: strict W3C v00 (version/length/hex checks, all-zero trace-id rejected), malformed → regenerated per EC-056-1. PipelineTests test 1: GET /no-such-route-m0 — the body's correlationId equals the Serilog log-context value for that request, and the response `traceparent` header carries the same trace ID (TA-10.1 in→out). |
| AC-056-2 errors are Problem+JSON, always | PipelineTests tests 1 & 2: 404 → NOT_FOUND with the exact TA-4.1.3 field set (key set AND order pinned by `T-056-fix:`), and a forced unhandled exception via an injected test route → 500 INTERNAL with no stack frames or message text in the body. ProblemCodes is the single source of truth — exactly 17 consts, status+title pinned per code; business exceptions keep their own code (EC-056-2). |
| AC-056-3 rate limiting bites on auth bursts | T-056-03 live verification against the running API: 6 rapid requests to /api/v1/auth/* from one IP within a minute → the 6th returns 429 Problem+JSON RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After. Rule pinned in Program.cs (`*:/api/v1/auth/*`, 5/min, per IP) via AspNetCoreRateLimit 5.0.0; Kestrel flush ordering documented (header set before StartAsync). |
| AC-056-4 telemetry events use the closed set | TelemetryEventsTests: exact-set equality against TA-10.2 verbatim (21 event + 7 metric = 28 consts) plus a reflection count that catches computed members; PII transforms pinned with SHA-256/HMAC-SHA-256 test vectors (TA-9.4). WaTelemetryReporterTests: rendered template text IS the exact closed event name, upload_completed properties pinned verbatim; ad-hoc names throw before emission (EC-056-4). PipelineTests test 3: real Serilog pipeline emits upload_started with only the SourceContext property — TA-10.5 holds end-to-end. |

In-session review (`.omp/review-fnd008-{app,infra,tests}.md`) found one issue and two minors — all fixed in `T-056-fix:` (9491dc8): the CORS middleware now sets `Vary: Origin` on every allowed-origin response (not just OPTIONS preflights), PipelineTests test 1 pins the exact Problem+JSON key set and order, and T-001-05 / T-007-02 / T-007-04 task docs are aligned to TA-4.1.3's pinned 422 for TRANSFER_SIZE_EXCEEDED (spec line 459; code already matched spec).

§4 gate green at `T-056-fix:` — wa.domain.unit 37/37, wa.application.unit 33/33, wa.api.integration 13/13; wa.web lint/test/build clean.
